entries.prompt_text: Modern tarot card illustration, The Chariot. A woman drives a light purple vintage car along a winding coastal mountain road, viewed from behind at a distance. Through the back window: books, notebooks, laptop, luggage, and blankets fill the backseat. Two cats ride on the car's roof one orange and white, one black and white; subtle cat stickers and paw print charm visible. Vast peaceful landscape: sparkling blue sea, layered green mountains, small islands, distant seaside town, sailboats, wildflowers, warm sunset, peach pink clouds, multiple winding roads. No volcano. Style: whimsical adult storybook tarot, flat hand painted shapes, soft gouache, pastel, colored pencil, subtle paper collage texture. Charming and cozy, not childish. Palette: ivory, sky blue, soft green, peach. No sepia or vintage tint. Elegant ivory tarot border, delicate gold celestial details, Roman numeral VII at top, "THE CHARIOT" at bottom. Vertical composition.
